from hypothesis import given, settings
import hypothesis.strategies as st


@settings(deadline=None)
@given(text=st.text(min_size=0, max_size=50))
def test_never_crashes_on_arbitrary_input(text: str) -> None:
    escape_typst_characters(text)


def test_silently_ignores_os_error(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("pkg.get_cache", lambda: "/nonexistent/path")
    write_version_cache("2.0.0")
